## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and why it is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] Release build and relevant .NET tests pass.
- [ ] Browser Node tests pass when extension code changed.
- [ ] Real WPF/Chrome/Edge/hardware behavior is described without overstating mock evidence.
- [ ] Audio restoration and resource cleanup were considered.
- [ ] Repository audit passes.

## Security, privacy, and licenses

- [ ] No secrets, full logs, raw device IDs, browser profiles, page titles/URLs, user paths, or personal data are included.
- [ ] New dependencies/assets have documented licenses and provenance.
- [ ] No remote code, telemetry, driver, or Windows-default-device workaround was added.
- [ ] AI-assisted code, if any, was reviewed under `AI_DEVELOPMENT.md`; the submitter remains responsible.
